covered.rule: 1 opening: automated assistant of Bank 10, call recorded; ask with title and last name
2 never say collections, debt, payment, credit card, loan before verification
3 ask once more; still unclear -> not_reached/unclear
4 scam: verify via customer service number, continue
5 third party: say nothing, ask when reachable
6 callback next business day 12:00-18:00, after now -> not_reached/callback
7 outside window ask once more -> not_reached/no_callback
13 failed: mobile app or branch -> not_verified/failed
18 debt intro, up to 2 products, state all, ask once pay all today
20 full first, never ask how much, floor once, 'the rest stays overdue'
22 band1 1-52 last business day of month, 1 attempt
23 attempt 1 full on last business day this/next week (floor if full refused); attempt 2 floor on deadline
25 already paid sentence, note paid, continue
27 hardship: sympathy, offer support transfer, decline -> no_promise/hardship, may still promise
29 human after verification, no 'can I help'
30 read-back 'Do you confirm?', one promise per product
31 text message sentence after successful write
34 common date clamped, one read-back, transfer keeps promise
35 one note per unpromised product, no notes on transfer
